const payload = $json.body ?? $json;

const title = String(payload.title || '').trim();
const excerpt = String(payload.excerpt || '').trim();
const content = String(payload.content || '').trim();
const category = String(payload.category || '').trim();
const sourceUrl = String(payload.source_url || '').trim();
const requestedBy = payload.requested_by || {};

const searchContent = content.length > 1800
  ? content.slice(0, 1800) + '...'
  : content;

const draftBlock = [
  `Title: ${title || '[empty]'}`,
  `Category: ${category || '[empty]'}`,
  `Summary: ${excerpt || '[empty]'}`,
  `Reference URL: ${sourceUrl || '[none]'}`,
  'Content:',
  searchContent || '[empty]'
].join('\n');

const searchPrompt = [
  'You are helping SharedSpace verify a user-submitted article draft.',
  'Find Straits Times articles that are genuinely similar to the draft topic or core claims.',
  'Return only the best matches from straitstimes.com.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact shape:',
  '{',
  '  "search_summary": "",',
  '  "matched_articles": [',
  '    {',
  '      "title": "",',
  '      "url": "",',
  '      "relevance_note": ""',
  '    }',
  '  ]',
  '}',
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Search only The Straits Times.',
  '- Return up to 3 matched articles.',
  '- Prefer articles that directly support, overlap with, or meaningfully challenge the draft topic.',
  '- If there are no strong matches, explain that in search_summary and return an empty array.',
  '- Use the title, summary, and trimmed content excerpt to infer the topic.',
  '',
  'Draft article:',
  draftBlock
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    title,
    excerpt,
    content,
    category,
    source_url: sourceUrl,
    requested_by: requestedBy,
    draft_block: draftBlock,
    search_prompt: searchPrompt
  }
}];
